set.Finding quote: However, the contents of these two species were different between the two isoforms (apoE3-(1–231), 43% for s = 2.2 and 42% for s = 5.0 versus apoE4-(1–231), 29% for s = 2.0 and 53% for s = 4.9).
set.Finding description: In PBS, the tetramer-like peak accounted for 53% of apoE4-(1–231) versus 42% of apoE3-(1–231). The monomer-like peak accounted for 29% versus 43%, respectively.

why: The new quote (53% vs 42% tetramer-like, 29% vs 43% monomer-like, Fig 1D) is verbatim and matches the description, but these are integrated areas of the SEDFIT-fitted c(s) distribution, so 1.26x is a ratio of fitted-model output and the effect stays qualitative; purified protein in PBS is class 3/3.

632 vs 243 kDa are best-fit species masses from the SEDPHAT global discrete model (Table 2), a fitted model parameter, so 2.60x is not an effect size and the row stays qualitative; the purified-fragment-in-PBS readout is class 3/3, not 1/2.

205 vs 162 kDa are single-species best-fit Meq values (Table 1 footnote: 'Best fit calculated molar mass'), so 0.79x is a ratio of fitted parameters and the effect stays qualitative; cell-free PBS readout is class 3/3.

set.Finding summary: Full-length apoE showed similar overall distributions in PBS, with a slightly lower fraction above 11 S for apoE4.
set.Data location: Fig. 1B and the accompanying Results on p. 13335, integrated fraction at s > 11 S

why: Results print 12% (apoE3) vs 11% (apoE4) for s > 11 and the new description is accurate, but these are integrated areas of the fitted c(s) distribution, so 0.92x is not an effect size; qualitative, class 3/3 for purified apoE in PBS.

set.Finding description: In 50 mM DHPC, the equivalent molar masses of full-length apoE4 and apoE3 were 34 and 33 kDa, respectively, close to the 35-kDa theoretical monomer mass. The three truncated isoform pairs in Table 1 also had monomer-like masses.
set.Finding summary: Full-length apoE4 and apoE3 both had monomer-like equivalent masses in DHPC, at 34 and 33 kDa, respectively.
set.Experimental system: Purified recombinant human apoE proteins at 0.5 mg/ml in PBS with 50 mM DHPC. Sedimentation-equilibrium data at 20 °C were fitted with a single-species model.
set.Data location: Table 1, full-length ApoE3 and ApoE4 rows, Mass in PBS containing 50 mM DHPC column. Results on p. 13337 also cite supplementary Fig. 2S.
